description: One Advanced Strategies rule's state today: each fund's signal with its distance from the line, target holdings in percent, next signal and trade dates, last moves and the tracked blotter (last blotter_limit hypothetical trades). ETFIQ places no orders; nothing here is an instruction. Takes a slug from strategy_list.

blotter_limit.description: Most recent tracked blotter rows to return, 0 to 50. Default 10.
